e.title: 阿联酋健康险端到端定价模型：十八个 R 脚本，把「当前保费」与「未来保费」全程分列两栏，因为文档明言把两者混起来会让赔付率看起来好得不真实或坏得不真实
e.title_en: An end-to-end UAE health insurance pricing model in eighteen R scripts that keeps current and future premium in two separate columns throughout, because its documentation states that mixing them makes loss ratios look misleadingly good or bad
e.title_hk: 阿聯酋健康險端到端定價模型：十八個 R 腳本，把「當前保費」與「未來保費」全程分列兩欄，因為文檔明言把兩者混起來會讓賠付率看起來好得不真實或壞得不真實
e.summary: 一个针对阿联酋健康险的端到端定价模型，以 2022–2024 三个历史队列训练、2024 年验证、2025 年定价：GLM 按年龄性别、国籍、健康状况、诊断类型、计划与网络估计索赔频率与强度，两者相乘得到纯保费；全部假设集中在一个 1,419 字节的「治理与假设」脚本里且每行带来源注释；续保采用平方根可信度加权混合 2024 实际经验与 GLM 估计，费率变动限制在 -10% 至 +35% 之间并对照 2026 年阿联酋最低保费；文档把「当前保费」与「未来保费」必须分列称为一条要点，理由是混起来会让赔付率看起来好得不真实或坏得不真实；作者另单列一节「诚实的局限」，说明数据是自己生成的合成数据
e.summary_hk: 一個針對阿聯酋健康險的端到端定價模型，以 2022–2024 三個歷史隊列訓練、2024 年驗證、2025 年定價：GLM 按年齡性別、國籍、健康狀況、診斷類型、計劃與網絡估計索賠頻率與強度，兩者相乘得到純保費；全部假設集中在一個 1,419 位元組的「治理與假設」腳本裡且每行帶來源註釋；續保採用平方根可信度加權混合 2024 實際經驗與 GLM 估計，費率變動限制在 -10% 至 +35% 之間並對照 2026 年阿聯酋最低保費；文檔把「當前保費」與「未來保費」必須分列稱為一條要點，理由是混起來會讓賠付率看起來好得不真實或壞得不真實；作者另單列一節「誠實的局限」，說明數據是自己生成的合成數據
e.summary_en: An end-to-end pricing model for UAE health insurance that trains on three historical cohorts from 2022–2024, validates on 2024 and prices 2025: a GLM estimates claim frequency and severity per member from age and sex, nationality, health condition, diagnosis type, plan and network, and their product gives the pure premium; every assumption sits in a single 1,419-byte governance-and-assumptions script with an inline source comment on each line; renewal uses square-root credibility to blend 2024 actual experience with the GLM estimate, with rate changes capped between -10% and +35% and checked against 2026 UAE minimum premiums; the documentation makes keeping current and future premium in separate columns an explicit point, on the ground that mixing them makes loss ratios look misleadingly good or bad; and the author devotes a separate section to honest limitations, stating that the data is synthetic and self-generated
e.body:
**uae-health-pricing-model**（仓库 `Udit1609/UAE-Health-Insurance-Pricing-Model`）是一个**针对阿联酋（UAE）健康险的端到端定价模型**：**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 R、仓库体量 29 KB、创建于 2026-09-08、最后推送 2026-09-08**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，创建与推送均落在解冻窗口之后**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 实测 404，README 亦无许可章节——属本站记录的「完全未声明」形态）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 6,519 字节（英语）**。**已实测存在的文件**（**经下载 tarball 后逐一列出，共 19 个条目：18 个 `.R` 脚本加 `README.md`，且文件名与 README 的「Files in order」表逐条对应**）：**`Package setup.R`、`Governance and Assumptions.R`、`Generate 2025 base portfolio.R`、`Member expansion - 2025 portfolio.R`、`Diagnosis and Prior claim.R`、`Frequency effect’s and claim count.R`（**⚠️ 该文件名在仓库中实际使用**直撇号 ASCII U+0027**，**本站按内容规范统一渲染为弯撇号 U+2019**）、`Severity effect and gross claim amount.R`、`Benefit Design and Reinsurance.R`、`Data Quality + conversion to Health model.R`、`Generating historical Cohorts 2022 - 2024.R`、`Train & Validate & Price split.R`、`Frequency GLM.R`、`Severity GLM.R`、`Apply pricing to 2025 portfolio.R`、`Portfolio and Segment profitability.R`、`Credibility renewal pricing.R`、`Anti Selection and Diagnosis mix.R`、`Main.R`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「不让降级悄悄发生」**中的**第三种，也是四条里最贴近**日常定价工作台上会真实发生的那种悄悄出错**的一条**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与源码逐字实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其「为什么这样做」一节的第一条就是本轮主题最具体的样本**——**逐字为**：**「**Current vs future premium separation** — I keep two separate premium columns throughout. Current premium is what the policyholder pays in 2025 **with no trend applied**. Future premium applies the 11.3% medical trend and is used for renewal pricing, stress testing and IFRS17 projections. **Mixing these up is a common mistake that makes loss ratios look misleadingly good or bad.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **「把两者混起来是一个常见的错误，它会让赔付率看起来好得不真实或坏得不真实」这句话点出的是一个**没有报错、没有异常、只是数字变得更好看或更难看**的失败**：**没有趋势的当前保费与含趋势的未来保费一旦混用，**赔付率的分母就换了含义**，而**分子分母都还在、比率照样算得出来、模型照样跑得通****。**本条目的处理极其朴素**：**全程保留两栏**（**「I keep two separate premium columns throughout」**）**——**即在数据结构的层面让这两件事**不可能被偶然合并****（**⚠️ 本词条**未读源码**，**故**不主张该分离在代码中确实逐处成立**——**本词条只核实其「治理与假设」脚本中**唯一一处被刻意共享**的派生值见下**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其「治理与假设」脚本实测为 1,419 字节，且**每一行假设都带来源注释**，这是本条目第二个具体机制**——**逐行逐字实测**：**`medical_trend <- 0.113   # WTW 2026 Middle East Survey`**；**`historical_volume_factors <- c("2022"=0.70,"2023"=0.82,"2024"=0.91,"2025"=1.00)`**（**并逐字注释**「Portfolio was smaller in earlier years」**）；**`target_loss_ratio <- 0.85`**；**`admin_expense_loading <- 0.10`、`commission_loading <- 0.02`、`risk_margin <- 0.03`、`profit_loading <- 0.05`**；**`csection_rate_base <- 0.38`、`normal_delivery_cost_aed <- 12000`、`csection_cost_aed <- 18000`**；**`rate_change_floor <- -0.10`、`rate_change_ceiling <- 0.35`、`full_credibility_exposure <- 100`**；**`reinsurance_retention <- 35000`、`reinsurance_ceded_share <- 0.90`**；**`valuation_date <- as.Date("2025-12-31")`、`n_policies <- 25000`、`year_claim_volatility <- 0.05`**。⭐⭐⭐ **而这一整份文件里**只有一处**被刻意共享**，且**注释把它点明了**：**逐字为** **「# Pricing load multiplier used for **BOTH** current and future premium」**，**紧接着** **`pricing_load_multiplier <- 1 + admin_expense_loading + commission_loading + risk_margin + profit_loading`**⭐⭐⭐ **即：**两栏保费是分开的，但**附加费用乘数**是同一个，而且**用一个大写 BOTH 在代码里写明了这是有意的****——**对做定价的同学，这是一处很值得记住的颗粒度选择**：**费用的加载方式不随趋势变化，故可以共享；价格的时点含义随趋势变化，故必须分开**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这一划分对任何其他险种同样适用**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **README 的假设表给每条假设配了**来源**一列，而**代码注释里的措辞比 README 表更保守**——这处差异必须如实写出**：**README 表逐字为**：**「Medical trend | 11.3% | WTW 2026 Middle East Survey」**、**「EBP minimum premium Dubai | AED 620 (2025) / AED 635 (2026) | **DHA circular**」**、**「Federal basic premium | AED 310 (2025) / AED 320 (2026) | **UAE Federal Decree Jan 2025**」**、**「IFRS17 discount rate | 3.65% | CBUAE base rate Jan 2026」**、**「Reinsurance retention | AED 35,000 per member | Treaty design」**、**「Reinsurance ceded share | 90% of excess | Treaty design」**；**⚠️ 而 `Governance and Assumptions.R` 里对应两行逐字为** **`ebp_minimum_premium_2025 <- 620    # **approx** DHA 2025`**、**`ebp_minimum_premium_2026 <- 635    # **approx** DHA 2026 (Jan increase)`**、**`federal_basic_premium_2025 <- 310  # UAE federal 2025`**、**`federal_basic_premium_2026 <- 320  # UAE federal 2026 (Jan increase)`**⭐⭐⭐ **即**代码里写的是「approx DHA」，README 表里写成了「DHA circular」；联邦基础保费在代码里只有「UAE federal 2025」，表里补成了「UAE Federal Decree Jan 2025」****——**⚠️ 这是**同一份仓库内部对同一条假设的**来源把握程度不一致**：代码更谨慎、README 表更确定****。**本词条据此**只记录两处措辞的差异，**不判断哪一处准确、也不主张这两个来源是否确实存在****（**⚠️ 本次**未查** DHA 通函、阿联酋联邦法令或 CBUAE 基准利率**）**——**对做模型的同学，这是一处**很实用的提醒**：**摘要表往往比代码注释「更像有依据」**，**而差异正好出现在这两者之间**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「诚实的局限」一节是本条的第四处机制，且措辞没有任何缓冲**——**逐字为**：**「The data is **synthetic** — I generated it to demonstrate the methodology rather than to produce real market rates. In a production environment you would replace the synthetic data with actual policy, claims and exposure extracts. The nationality relativities and development patterns are based on publicly available UAE market information and **would need calibrating against real portfolio experience**.」**⭐⭐ **它把「这份模型不能用来做什么」写成了两句具体的替换指令**（**换成真实保单／索赔／暴露数据；国籍相对数与进展模式需按真实组合经验校准**）；**并逐字说明建模动机**：**「I built this model to demonstrate how a health insurer in the UAE would approach end-to-end actuarial pricing — from raw policy data all the way through to **renewal rate recommendations and regulatory compliance checks**. … **structured the way I would expect to see it in a real pricing team**.」**⭐⭐ **而其中的训练／验证／定价三段切分逐字为**：**「Instead of pricing on one year of data I generate 2022, 2023 and 2024 historical cohorts by sampling and **trend-deflating** the 2025 base. **The GLM trains on 2022-2023, validates on 2024 and prices on 2025.**」**⭐⭐ **「按趋势把 2025 年基数**反向通缩**造出历史队列」这一做法在本条应如实记为**作者的构造方法**，而**不是**真实历史数据**（**⚠️ 即该三个队列本身由 2025 年合成基数派生**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **可核实的模型结果与三个诊断量逐字**：**「268,801 members across 25,000 policies」**；**「Portfolio loss ratio: 94.5% on current premium basis」**（**对照 `target_loss_ratio <- 0.85`**）；**「GLM validated on 2024 holdout — **A/E ratio 0.993**」**；**「**Poisson dispersion ratio 1.022 — Poisson correctly retained**」**；**「4 diagnostic graphs and 11 CSV outputs」**⭐⭐ **「泊松离散度比 1.022」值得单独记一句**：**它是在**检验「泊松分布这个假设是否站得住」****，**而结论被写成「**泊松被正确地保留**」**——**即先做过度离散检验、再决定是否换模型**（**可与第 330 轮「把假设写成可核对的明文」并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**该离散度的计算方式或阈值判据**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其阿联酋市场特征逐字且具体**：**「The model reflects the actual regulatory structure including **DHA EBP minimum premiums, UAE federal basic premium, three DHA network tiers, five nationality groups with separate frequency and severity relativities, C-section shock at the UAE 38% rate, and spouse minimum age of 23 with child nationality following the father**.」**⭐⭐ **其中三条是**具体的市场与监管结构****：**DHA（迪拜卫生局）的 EBP 最低保费、三档 DHA 网络层级、按五个国籍分组分别设频率与强度相对数**；**并含一条**性别与家庭结构规则**——**配偶最低年龄 23 岁、子女国籍随父亲**（**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**这些规则是否与阿联酋现行监管或任何保险公司的实际做法一致**——**本次未查 DHA 规则、联邦法令或任何公司核保手册**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **续保环节的两个约束逐字**：**「Each policy gets a **credibility-weighted** renewal rate using 2024 actual experience blended with the GLM estimate. **Rate changes are capped between -10% and +35%** and **checked against UAE regulatory minimum premiums for 2026**.」**；**「`Governance and Assumptions.R` 中对应为 `rate_change_floor <- -0.10`、`rate_change_ceiling <- 0.35`、`full_credibility_exposure <- 100`」**⭐⭐ **「费率变动被限制在 −10% 与 +35% 之间」是一条**不对称的**价格约束**（**向下 10%、向上 35%**），**而 `full_credibility_exposure <- 100` 是**完全可信度所需的暴露量**（**其 README 的第四张图逐字为「Credibility Z plotted against combined exposure with theoretical curve」**）**——**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**该可信度公式（README 称 square-root credibility）或该阈值 100 的来源**。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **四张诊断图与十一份 CSV 输出**（**逐字**）：**`graph_01_lr_heatmap.png`（「Loss ratio by plan type and region — green to red scale」）**、**`graph_02_current_vs_future_premium.png`（「Side by side current vs future premium by plan type」）**、**`graph_03_renewal_distribution.png`（「How many policies are getting each level of rate change」）**、**`graph_04_credibility_curve.png`**⭐⭐ **第二张图**正好是第①点的可视化**：**「当前与未来保费并排」被做成了一张专门的图**——**即那条纪律不只写在代码结构里，也写进了交付物**（**⚠️ **⚠️ 但本次实测该仓库**不含任何 PNG 或 CSV**：tarball 全部 19 个条目只有 18 个脚本加 README，**README 所称的输出目录 `UAE_Health_Pricing_Model_Outputs/` 并不在仓库中**——**即图与 CSV 是**运行后生成**的，不是已提交的产物**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站定价引擎、可信度与 GLM 条目并读**：[[quote-engine-reference-architecture]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[burncost]]、[[insurance-credibility]]、[[experience-rating-insurance-pricing]]、[[ratingtables]]、[[glmmnet]]、[[aglm]]、[[tweedie-python]]、[[insurance-pricing-demo]]、[[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[actuarial-tools-bmk]]、[[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️ **README 的运行说明里有一处**大小写不一致，且足以让人第一次就失败****：**README 逐字写**「Then run each file in the order listed below, or **use `source("main.R")` to run the whole model at once**」**，**⚠️ 而实测该文件的实际名称为 **`Main.R`**（**首字母大写**）**——**在区分大小写的文件系统上（**如 Linux**），`source("main.R")` 会失败**；**而在默认不区分大小写的系统上（**如 macOS**）则可以成功**——**⚠️ 即这是一处**取决于运行环境**的隐蔽不一致**（**⚠️ 本词条**未实际运行 `source("main.R")` 验证**，**故记为**基于文件名与文档措辞的对照****）。**② ⚠️⭐ **仓库描述与 README 之间有一处**范围表述的张力**，如实记录**：**其 GitHub 描述逐字为**「End-to-end actuarial pricing model for UAE health insurance built in R (**Excluding IFRS 17**)」**，**而 README 逐字说未来保费**「is used for renewal pricing, stress testing and **IFRS17 projections**」**，**且假设表含**「IFRS17 discount rate | 3.65% | CBUAE base rate Jan 2026」**⭐⭐ **⚠️ 两处说法并不必然矛盾**（**描述说的是**不包含 IFRS 17 计量本身**，而 README 说的是该列保费**会被用于 IFRS 17 预测**，**并使用了其折现率**），**⚠️ 但本词条**不替作者调和二者**，**只如实并列**，**并提示读者以仓库描述为准理解其范围**（**⚠️ 本次**未查** CBUAE 2026 年 1 月基准利率是否为 3.65%**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **其输出未入库**：**README 逐字说**「All outputs will appear in `UAE_Health_Pricing_Model_Outputs/`」**，**⚠️ 但本次实测 tarball 的 19 个条目里**既无该目录，也无任何 PNG 或 CSV****——**即**四张图与十一份 CSV 均为**运行后生成**，**本词条据此**不主张**其任何数值结果或图形已可查看或已复核**（**⚠️ 其 README 列出的多个数值——94.5% 赔付率、A/E 0.993、泊松离散度 1.022、268,801 名成员——**本词条只记录 README 如此声明，**未运行模型、未见过任何输出文件**）。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **许可实测为**无**（`LICENSE` 404，README **无许可章节**）**——**属「完全未声明」形态**；**本词条据此提示：使用、复制或再分发前应先向作者确认授权****。**⑤** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、README（6,519 字节）全文（含三个设问、关键数字、三处「为什么这样建」的设计说明、假设与来源表、运行四步、十八个文件的用途表、四张图说明、诚实的局限、以及 About 一节）**，**以及 `Governance and Assumptions.R` 的全文（1,419 字节，逐行读取）**；**并以 tarball 列出全部 19 个条目以核实文件名与 README 表格的对应关系、并确认无输出文件**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 R、未运行 `Package setup.R` 或任何脚本、未运行 `source("main.R")`、**未读其余 17 个脚本的源码**、未读任何输出、未生成任何图**，因此**不能转述其 GLM 的具体设定、系数取值、可信度公式、损失率计算口径、续保实施方式或任何数值结果**；**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「当前保费与未来保费全程分列」是否在代码中确实成立**（**本次只读了集中假设的那一个脚本**）**——**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其 GLM 的具体族与连接函数、年龄性别交互项、国籍相对数的估计方式、以及「泊松离散度比」的计算与判据**；**⑧ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其平方根可信度续保的实现与 `full_credibility_exposure <- 100` 的来源**；**⑨ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其赔付率 94.5%、A/E 0.993、泊松离散度 1.022、成员数 268,801 可核實資訊（**均 README 與源碼逐字實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其「為什麼這樣做」一節的第一條就是本輪主題最具體的樣本**——**逐字**：**「**Current vs future premium separation** — I keep two separate premium columns throughout. Current premium is what the policyholder pays in 2025 **with no trend applied**. Future premium applies the 11.3% medical trend and is used for renewal pricing, stress testing and IFRS17 projections. **Mixing these up is a common mistake that makes loss ratios look misleadingly good or bad.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **這句話點出的是一個**沒有報錯、沒有異常、只是數字變得更好看或更難看**的失敗**：**沒有趨勢的當前保費與含趨勢的未來保費一旦混用，**賠付率的分母就換了含義**，而**分子分母都還在、比率照樣算得出來、模型照樣跑得通****。**本條目的處理極其樸素**：**全程保留兩欄**——**即在數據結構層面讓這兩件事**不可能被偶然合併****（**⚠️ 未讀源碼，故不主張該分離在代碼中確實逐處成立**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **其「治理與假設」腳本實測為 1,419 位元組，且**每一行假設都帶來源註釋****——**逐行逐字實測**：**`medical_trend <- 0.113   # WTW 2026 Middle East Survey`**；**`historical_volume_factors <- c("2022"=0.70,"2023"=0.82,"2024"=0.91,"2025"=1.00)`**（**逐字註釋**「Portfolio was smaller in earlier years」**）；**`target_loss_ratio <- 0.85`**；**`admin_expense_loading <- 0.10`、`commission_loading <- 0.02`、`risk_margin <- 0.03`、`profit_loading <- 0.05`**；**`csection_rate_base <- 0.38`、`normal_delivery_cost_aed <- 12000`、`csection_cost_aed <- 18000`**；**`rate_change_floor <- -0.10`、`rate_change_ceiling <- 0.35`、`full_credibility_exposure <- 100`**；**`reinsurance_retention <- 35000`、`reinsurance_ceded_share <- 0.90`**；**`valuation_date <- as.Date("2025-12-31")`、`n_policies <- 25000`、`year_claim_volatility <- 0.05`**。⭐⭐⭐ **而這整份文件裡**只有一處**被刻意共享，且註釋把它點明了**：**逐字** **「# Pricing load multiplier used for **BOTH** current and future premium」**，**緊接** **`pricing_load_multiplier <- 1 + admin_expense_loading + commission_loading + risk_margin + profit_loading`**⭐⭐⭐ **即：兩欄保費分開，但**附加費用乘數**是同一個，並用大寫 BOTH 寫明這是刻意的****——**對做定價的同學，這是一處值得記住的顆粒度選擇**：**費用的加載方式不隨趨勢變化，故可共享；價格的時點含義隨趨勢變化，故必須分開**（**⚠️ 不主張此劃分對其他險種同樣適用**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **README 假設表給每條假設配了**來源**一列，而**代碼註釋的措辭比 README 表更保守**——這處差異必須如實寫出**：**README 表逐字**：**「Medical trend | 11.3% | WTW 2026 Middle East Survey」「EBP minimum premium Dubai | AED 620 (2025) / AED 635 (2026) | **DHA circular**」「Federal basic premium | AED 310 (2025) / AED 320 (2026) | **UAE Federal Decree Jan 2025**」「IFRS17 discount rate | 3.65% | CBUAE base rate Jan 2026」「Reinsurance retention | AED 35,000 per member | Treaty design」「Reinsurance ceded share | 90% of excess | Treaty design」**；**⚠️ 而 `Governance and Assumptions.R` 對應兩行逐字為** **`ebp_minimum_premium_2025 <- 620    # **approx** DHA 2025`**、**`ebp_minimum_premium_2026 <- 635    # **approx** DHA 2026 (Jan increase)`**、**`federal_basic_premium_2025 <- 310  # UAE federal 2025`**、**`federal_basic_premium_2026 <- 320  # UAE federal 2026 (Jan increase)`**⭐⭐⭐ **即**代碼寫的是「approx DHA」，README 表寫成了「DHA circular」；聯邦基礎保費在代碼裡只有「UAE federal 2025」，表裡補成了「UAE Federal Decree Jan 2025」****——**⚠️ 這是**同一倉庫內部對同一條假設的**來源把握程度不一致**：代碼更謹慎，表更確定****。**本詞條據此**只記錄兩處措辭差異，**不判斷哪一處準確、也不主張這兩個來源是否確實存在****（**⚠️ 未查 DHA 通函、阿聯酋聯邦法令或 CBUAE 基準利率**）——**對做模型的同學，這是**很實用的提醒**：**摘要表往往比代碼註釋「更像有依據」，而差異正好出現在這兩者之間**。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其「誠實的局限」一節措辭沒有任何緩衝**——**逐字**：**「The data is **synthetic** — I generated it to demonstrate the methodology rather than to produce real market rates. In a production environment you would replace the synthetic data with actual policy, claims and exposure extracts. The nationality relativities and development patterns are based on publicly available UAE market information and **would need calibrating against real portfolio experience**.」**⭐⭐ **它把「這份模型不能用來做什麼」寫成了兩句具體的替換指令**；**並逐字說明建模動機**：**「I built this model to demonstrate how a health insurer in the UAE would approach end-to-end actuarial pricing — from raw policy data all the way through to **renewal rate recommendations and regulatory compliance checks**. … **structured the way I would expect to see it in a real pricing team**.」**⭐⭐ **訓練／驗證／定價三段切分逐字**：**「Instead of pricing on one year of data I generate 2022, 2023 and 2024 historical cohorts by sampling and **trend-deflating** the 2025 base. **The GLM trains on 2022-2023, validates on 2024 and prices on 2025.**」**⭐⭐ **「按趨勢把 2025 年基數反向通縮造出歷史隊列」應如實記為**作者的構造方法**，而非真實歷史數據**（**⚠️ 即該三個隊列本身由 2025 年合成基數派生**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **可核實的結果與三個診斷量逐字**：**「268,801 members across 25,000 policies」「Portfolio loss ratio: 94.5% on current shock at the UAE 38% rate, and spouse minimum age of 23 with child nationality following the father**.」**⭐⭐ **其中三條是**具體的市場與監管結構**：**DHA（迪拜衛生局）的 EBP 最低保費、三檔 DHA 網絡層級、按五個國籍分組分別設頻率與強度相對數**；**並含一條**性別與家庭結構規則**——**配偶最低年齡 23 歲、子女國籍隨父親**（**⚠️ 未核實這些規則是否與阿聯酋現行監管或任何保險公司實際做法一致**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **續保環節兩個約束逐字**：**「Each policy gets a **credibility-weighted** renewal rate using 2024 actual experience blended with the GLM estimate. **Rate changes are capped between -10% and +35%** and **checked against UAE regulatory minimum premiums for 2026**.」**；**對應 `rate_change_floor <- the time meaning of the price does vary with trend, so it must not be** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim this division applies to any other line of business**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The README’s assumption table carries a Source column, and the code comments are more cautious in wording than the table — a difference that must be recorded plainly**: **the README table reads verbatim**: **"Medical trend | 11.3% | WTW 2026 Middle East Survey"; **corresponding to `rate_change_floor <- -0.10`, `rate_change_ceiling <- 0.35` and `full_credibility_exposure <- 100`** ⭐⭐ **The rate-change cap is an asymmetric price constraint (10% down, 35% up), and `full_credibility_exposure <- 100` is the exposure needed for full credibility** (**its fourth figure reads verbatim "Credibility Z plotted against combined exposure with theoretical curve"**) — **⚠️ the credibility formula (described as square-root credibility) and the origin of the 100 threshold were not verified**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Four diagnostic graphs and eleven CSV outputs, verbatim**: **`graph_01_lr_heatmap.png` ("Loss ratio by plan type and region — green to red scale"), `graph_02_current_vs_future_premium.png` ("Side by side current vs future premium by plan type"), `graph_03_renewal_distribution.png` ("How many policies are getting each level of rate change") and `graph_04_credibility_curve.png`** ⭐⭐ **The second figure is exactly the visual form of point ①: "current and future premium side by side" is made into a dedicated chart, so the discipline lives not only in the code structure but in the deliverable** (**⚠️ **⚠️ but this check measured no PNG or CSV at all in the repository**: all 19 tarball entries are 18 scripts plus the README, and the output directory the README names, `UAE_Health_Pricing_Model_Outputs/`, is not in the repository — **the figures and CSVs are generated by running, not committed artefacts**). **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s pricing-engine, credibility and GLM entries**: [[quote-engine-reference-architecture]], [[openrater]], [[ratecraft]], [[burncost]], [[insurance-credibility]], [[experience-rating-insurance-pricing]], [[ratingtables]], [[glmmnet]], [[aglm]], [[tweedie-python]], [[insurance-pricing-demo]], [[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]], [[actuarial-tools-bmk]] and [[tfm-pensiones-pnc-es]].
